origin.dylans_origin.dylans_origin.name: Shoulder Sprite
origin.dylans_origin.dylans_origin.descr: A tiny mischievous sprite with pixie magic and birb-like aerial instincts: small, lucky, glowing, shoulder-riding, lightly armored, and deadlier while gliding.
power.dylans_origin.dylans_origin/bite_s: You are now four times smaller with five less hearts.
power.dylans_origin.dylans_origin/effect: Being a being of pure fondness gives you permanent luck and a warming aura.
power.dylans_origin.dylans_origin/flying: You do not need to use fireworks, as you can gain a forwards and upwards boost using your magic. This version recharges every 2 seconds.
power.dylans_origin.dylans_origin/almost: You are very tiny, which makes it hard to wear any armor apart from leather, gold, chainmail, and iron chestplates.
power.dylans_origin.dylans_origin/jockey: Press your use key while looking at another player to ride on their shoulders.
power.dylans_origin.dylans_origin/more_a: While fall-flying, you deal twice as much damage.
